text:
maria (partner-eng): Quick heads-up — we should run a short interop + resilience smoke test across Snowflake, Databricks, and Qdrant connectors before the marketplace bundle announcement. @owen @sara can you join a 30m sync this week? :calendar:

owen (platform): Yep. Scope? full failover + rate-limit/backpressure + token rotations?

sara (sre): I suggest we keep blast radius small: one region at a time, use canary tenant, targets: connector health, KV cache validity, model routing fallback. SLOs: <500ms tail for simple lookups, <2s for gen fallback.

lee (eng-infra): I can spin a litmus/chaos-mesh job in staging. Proposal: 3 experiments — 1) network partition between eu-west and us-east for connector egress, 2) pod kill on vector DB replicas, 3) spike 10k req/min for 60s to observe batching/backpressure.

alex (partner-ops): From partner side we'll need a short comms note for Snowflake/Databricks PMs + a partner contact for Qdrant. Don't want surprises during cert window. I can own that.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: chaos-experiments/staging -> started by lee at 3302468100 (eta 15m). :rocket:

maria (partner-eng): Nice. Let's make a tight checklist. Draft: 
- confirm test tenants & entitlements 
- whitelist partner IPs or run in partner-sandbox 
- snapshot telemetry & perf baselines 
- run chaos experiments (one at a time) 
- validate fallback behavior and alerting 
- partner comms + blackout windows

owen (platform): Also add: verify routing policy fallback to smaller model / dedicated pool when capacity throttles. We saw a routing edge once where requests queued without fallback.

sara (sre): Health check snippet for connectors (use canary tenant):
```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $CANARY_TOKEN" 
  https://staging-infer.redwood.local/connectors/snowflake/health || echo "DOWN"
```
Expect 200 + {"ok":true, "kv_cache_version":"v3"}. If KV cache mismatch, run cache invalidation job.

lee (eng-infra): For the pod-kill we use this litmus experiment config (sample):
```yaml
apiVersion: litmuschaos.io/v1alpha1
kind: ChaosEngine
metadata:
  name: pod-kill-vectordb
spec:
  appinfo:
    appns: vector-staging
    applabel: qdrant-primary
  chaosServiceAccount: litmus-admin
  experiments:
    - name: pod-delete
      spec:
        components:
          env: []
```
I'll attach full manifest to the run doc.

alex (partner-ops): For partner comms: sample blurb -> "We'll run short resilience checks in staging on DATE between HH:MM-HH:MM UTC. No data will be modified; you may see transient errors. Reach out to <partner contact> if you see anything after test window." Can post to partner Slack channel.

maria (partner-eng): Owners & timeline: 
- lee: infra/chaos runs (Thu 09:00 UTC)
- sara: SRE validation & alerts (Thu 09:00 UTC + realtime)
- owen: routing/fallback checks + model fallback tests (Thu 09:00 UTC)
- alex: partner comms + blackout notice (by Wed EOD)

owen (platform): I'll add a tiny automated smoke that simulates model fallback by throttling the gen pool. Script will verify requests degrade gracefully to hosted small-model path.

sara (sre): Post-checks -> run these queries against telemetry: 
- error_rate > baseline*3? 
- median_latency shift > 2x? 
- cache_invalidation events triggered?
If any fail, abort announcement and run postmortem.

maria (partner-eng): Perfect. Alex can you draft the partner note and tag Snowflake/Databricks contacts? Lee, add the litmus manifests to the run doc and link the deploy-bot run. We'll meet Thu 08:30 UTC quick preflight. :thumbsup:

alex (partner-ops): On it. Drafting now, will ping infra + partner PMs.

lee (eng-infra): Manifests uploaded to: https://internal.redwood/sandbox/chaos/run-3302468013 and linked the deploy-bot run id. See run logs at 3302468105.

sara (sre): I'll prepare alert runbook and quick rollback steps.

maria (partner-eng): Thanks team — keeping this tight will save us headaches in the announcement week. See you Thu 08:30 UTC. :raised_hands:
